description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ResetPasswordDao, part of the authentication plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to resetting passwords, such as saving reset requests, fetching logs by reset code, and updating reset statuses.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ResetPasswordDao methods involving reset password requests within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up the ResetPasswordDao instance, loading test fixtures, and configuring mock services.

methods.name: testSaveResetPassword
methods.description: Tests the saving of a reset password request and verifies email and code fields.

methods.name: testGetResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of reset password log data based on reset code.

methods.name: testUpdateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Tests updating the validity status of a reset password request.
